judged_text: TopicEmbed declares belongs_to :topic/:post with no dependent cleanup, and nothing in the diff removes topic_embeds rows when their topic is deleted, while EmbedController#best (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:9-11) still looks up topics by the stale topic_id. After a moderator deletes an imported topic, topic_id_for_embed keeps returning the dead topic_id, TopicView.new raises on the missing topic, and the third-party page's embed iframe gets a permanent 500 on every pageview instead of falling back to retrieval or an empty state.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `topic_embeds` with `topic_id`/`post_id` columns (migration `20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb`) but adds no FK constraints or any deletion/cleanup logic in this PR. `EmbedController#best` relies solely on `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` and then unconditionally does `TopicView.new(topic_id, ...)` when a `topic_id` is returned, with no check that the topic still exists. If a `topic_embeds` row can remain after its topic/post are deleted, this could cause errors. However, whether topics/posts delete associated `topic_embeds` via code outside this diff (e.g., `has_many :topic_embeds, dependent: ...` on `Topic`/`Post`) or whether `TopicView.new` raises on missing topics is not shown in the diff, so the “permanent 500” outcome can’t be conclusively verified from the provided changes alone.
